That said, I acknowledge narrow moral justification in extreme survival situations, and as an engineer I favor practical reforms (simpler applications, presumptive eligibility, safe‑harbors, targeted audits, and data‑driven pilots) so people aren’t forced into deception and fraud is caught without punishing the vulnerable.
